reuse.why: Reuses the existing eligibility, amount conversion, tag extraction, batching and undo abstractions, but repeats category metadata queries.

duplication.why: The saved-template predicate and supporting metadata joins are repeated across six queries instead of shared.

placement.why: Eligibility remains in month-action.ts, database and sheet operations remain in actions.ts, and handler registration follows app.ts conventions.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their shared policy, registration and tests.

maintainability.why: The shared eligibility policy is straightforward, but duplicated SQL and query types that omit the new metadata make future policy changes fragile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions use shouldWriteMonthBudget, and the new action uses averageToBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated metadata projections and saved-template SQL predicate in actions.ts are direct copies rather than disguised implementations.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget adds the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter, removes action-specific dispatch, and retains all month-wide callers without adding action-specific branches.
